lines.name: H8 Raster encoder and operation memory: which encoding path, and which memory contract?
lines.detail: recommendation: H8-A for Monochrome, H8-B for Optimize — an owned image XObject, written by pdf-lib itself, with the canvas released before the samples are allocated. One A4 page at 300 dpi peaks at 66.4 MiB (8.0 B/px) at "readback", every term EXACT or source-derived. Inside 512 MiB: DeviceGray raw 30 pages @300 and 123 @150, DeviceGray FlateDecode 30/123, DeviceRGB 10/41; against 30/123 that the unadoptable estimate promised and 0/6 that the only fail-closed JPEG term allowed.

lines.name: H8-file-size Is a larger PDF acceptable as the price of an exact memory contract?
lines.detail: recommendation: measured at 150 dpi on the grey scan: production JPEG 0.3 MiB, owned DeviceGray FlateDecode 1.1 MiB, owned DeviceGray raw 2.1 MiB. FlateDecode keeps the guarantee — its whole lifetime is now source-derived — and most of the size; raw keeps the size exact before the page is rendered.
